name: referenceresolver-sp-prefix-builtin
body: Unit.Call treats an EXEC of any absent one- or two-part procedure whose name starts with sp_ or xp_ (ignoring case), or whose schema is sys, as the builtin unresolved call SYS.<NAME>, so a user-schema procedure such as dbo.sp_foo absent from the scope is reported as SYS.SP_FOO rather than as an external dbo.sp_foo. Upgrade if only sys-schema or schema-less sp_/xp_ names are to count as builtin.
